terms.meaning: The number that adds to a number to give 0. The additive inverse of 7 is −7.
One positive token and one negative token together, which make 0.

items.name: Signs in a product
items.formula: Same signs: positive. Different signs: negative.

items.name: Many negative numbers
items.formula: Even count: positive. Odd count: negative.

items.name: Properties of multiplication
items.formula: a × b = b × a and (a × b) × c = a × (b × c)

items.name: Multiplying a sum
items.formula: a × (b + c) = a × b + a × c

items.name: Signs in a division
items.formula: Same signs: positive. Different signs: negative.

items.name: Brahmagupta's names
items.formula: Dhana is positive, rina is negative, and shunya is zero
items.example: He gave rules for multiplying them, such as rina × rina = dhana.

mistakes.text: Two minus signs multiplied give a plus, but adding two negatives stays negative. (−3) × (−2) = 6, while (−3) + (−2) = −5.
Subtracting a negative adds it. 4 − (−12) is 16, not −8.
